text:
Your worst decision came from mixing emotions.

Wasn't the feeling itself. Was two feelings happening at once.

You wanted her and you felt threatened. Alone, either might pass. Together they mix into a compound that turns off your brain.

S*x plus jealousy equals a poison.

The man who stays sane is the man who stops first and asks himself: what am I actually feeling right now.

Name it. Jealousy. Shame. Wounded pride. Fear of losing.

Name it. Wait. Choose.

You stop being ruled the moment you stop hiding from what you're feeling.
caption:
Most men repeat their worst mistakes because they never learned to identify what they're feeling. This is the success habit that breaks the cycle.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
